import os, sys, importlib.util

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print("Files:", os.listdir('.'))
for mod in ['pandas', 'openpyxl', 'xlrd', 'xlwt', 'xlsxwriter']:
    print(mod, "available:", importlib.util.find_spec(mod) is not None)

import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print(z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8'))
print("\n--- content types ---")
print(z.read('[Content_Types].xml').decode('utf-8'))

import zipfile, shutil, os, re

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data.xlsx.new'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    names = zin.namelist()
    items = {n: zin.read(n) for n in names}

sheet = items['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = items['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# --- sheet1.xml edits ---
sheet = sheet.replace('dimension ref="A1:G10"', 'dimension ref="A1:H10"')
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')

# Header cell H1
old = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>'
new = old + '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin (%)</t></is></c></row>'
assert old in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# Data rows 2-9
for r in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = old + f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    assert old in sheet, old
    sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# Total row 10
old = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
new = old + '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>'
assert old in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old, new)

# --- styles.xml edits: add 0.0% number format (id 165) and two xfs ---
old = '<numFmts count="0"/>'
new = '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="165" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>'
assert old in styles
styles = styles.replace(old, new)

old = '<cellXfs count="3">'
new = ('<cellXfs count="5">'
       '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
       '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="2" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
       '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
       '<xf numFmtId="165" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/>'
       '<xf numFmtId="165" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/>'
       '</cellXfs>')
assert old in styles
styles = styles.replace(old, new)

# --- rebuild zip preserving entry order ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for n in names:
        data = items[n]
        if n == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = sheet.encode('utf-8')
        elif n == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = styles.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(n, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print("OK: sales_data.xlsx updated")

import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, zipfile, re
from pathlib import Path

def find_soffice():
    for name in ('soffice', 'soffice.bin', 'libreoffice'):
        p = shutil.which(name)
        if p:
            return p
    return None

def setup_macro():
    macro_dir = Path.home() / '.config' / 'libreoffice' / '4' / 'user' / 'basic' / 'Standard'
    macro_file = macro_dir / 'Module1.xba'
    if macro_file.exists() and 'RecalculateAndSave' in macro_file.read_text():
        return True
    if not macro_dir.exists():
        subprocess.run([soffice, '--headless', '--terminate_after_init'], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        macro_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    content = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE script:module PUBLIC "-//OpenOffice.org//DTD OfficeDocument 1.0//EN" "module.dtd">
<script:module xmlns:script="http://openoffice.org/2000/script" script:name="Module1" script:language="StarBasic">
    Sub RecalculateAndSave()
      ThisComponent.calculateAll()
      ThisComponent.store()
      ThisComponent.close(True)
    End Sub
</script:module>'''
    macro_file.write_text(content)
    return True

def check_errors(path):
    errors = ['#VALUE!', '#DIV/0!', '#REF!', '#NAME?', '#NULL!', '#NUM!', '#N/A']
    found = []
    formulas = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        for n in z.namelist():
            if n.startswith('xl/worksheets/') and n.endswith('.xml'):
                xml = z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
                for m in re.finditer(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>', xml):
                    if m.group(1).strip().startswith('#'):
                        found.append((n, m.group(1)))
                formulas += len(re.findall(r'<f>', xml))
    return found, formulas

soffice = find_soffice()
if not soffice:
    print(json.dumps({'error': 'LibreOffice not found'}, indent=2))
    sys.exit(1)

setup_macro()
abs_path = str(Path('sales_data.xlsx').absolute())
cmd = [soffice, '--headless', '--norestore',
       'vnd.sun.star.script:Standard.Module1.RecalculateAndSave?language=Basic&location=application',
       abs_path]
try:
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    print(json.dumps({'error': 'timeout during recalculation'}, indent=2))
    sys.exit(1)

if result.returncode != 0 and result.returncode != 124:
    print(json.dumps({'error': result.stderr or 'LibreOffice failed', 'rc': result.returncode}, indent=2))
    sys.exit(1)

found, formulas = check_errors('sales_data.xlsx')
out = {
    'status': 'success' if not found else 'errors_found',
    'total_errors': len(found),
    'total_formulas': formulas,
    'error_summary': {},
    'stderr_tail': (result.stderr or '')[-500:],
}
for loc, val in found:
    out['error_summary'].setdefault(val, {'count': 0, 'locations': []})
    out['error_summary'][val]['count'] += 1
    out['error_summary'][val]['locations'].append(loc)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
